question_text: Bill collects $\$81\,000$ as his share of a lottery win. He decides to retire from work and buy an annuity to provide $\$2000$ per month, until he gets a pension in four years' time.

subparts.stem: What annual interest rate, compounded monthly, is needed for Bill's plan to work?

mark_breakdown.desc: Set up TVM financial solver parameters with $N = 48$, $PV = -81\,000$, $PMT = 2000$, $FV = 0$, $P/Y = 12$, $C/Y = 12$

subparts.solution: $N = 4 \times 12 = 48$, $PV = -81\,000$, $PMT = 2000$, $FV = 0$, $P/Y = 12$, $C/Y = 12$. $\therefore I\% \approx 8.60$. Bill needs to receive $8.60\%$ p.a. compounded monthly.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Using a TVM solver to find the required annual interest rate for an annuity given present value, regular payment, and number of periods.
step_by_step: Input $PV = -81000$, $PMT = 2000$, $FV = 0$, and monthly compounding frequencies $P/Y = C/Y = 12$.
Solve for $I\%$ to obtain approximately $8.60\%$ per annum.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Incorrect sign convention for cash flows (PV and PMT must have opposite signs).

subparts.stem: How much will Bill actually receive each month over the period of the annuity if he receives $7\%$ p.a. interest compounded monthly?

mark_breakdown.desc: Set up TVM solver with $I\% = 7$ and other given parameters

subparts.solution: $N = 48$, $I\% = 7$, $PV = -81\,000$, $FV = 0$, $P/Y = 12$, $C/Y = 12$. $\therefore PMT \approx 1939.64$. Bill would receive $\$1939.64$ per month.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Calculating regular payments of an ordinary annuity with fixed interest rate and term.
step_by_step: State the payment rounded to two decimal places.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Failing to round monetary values to 2 decimal places.
